build_python_wheel: build a Python wheel archive using PythonWheelBuilder to install it as a CMake python library
parse_wheel_name: parse a Python wheel filename into distribution, version, build, python, abi, and platform components
read_wheel_metadata: read the WHEEL metadata file from a wheel's dist-info directory and return an email message object
convert_to_cmake_path: convert OS-specific file paths to forward-slash CMake-compatible paths for cross-platform compatibility
write_cmake_config: write CMakeLists.txt and config template files for a Python wheel library with dependency declarations
